rationale: The workflow already implements dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) for ~/.nuget/packages and .nuke/temp with a key derived from global.json, *.csproj, and Directory.Packages.props, so that optimization is present. The remaining workflow_yaml-scoped timing optimizations (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT / P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT) require representative successful-duration history to set a safe job budget, but the repository context reports measurement: not_a_measured_baseline with no run durations, so a timeout cannot be derived without risking the explicit contraindication that valid slow macOS runs exceed the limit, which would trim build/test coverage. Matrix-based (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), schedule-based (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE / P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), Bazel, and ci_service-scoped patterns do not fit this single-job macOS .NET/Nuke workflow. No supported prerequisite is met for a safe change, so the workflow is left unchanged to preserve intended build and test coverage.
